get.summary: Get a resource's stored representation (browser-friendly alias)
get.description: Identical pipe to GET /resources/{id} — verbatim bytes, stored media type in Content-Type, Accept never read. Exists only as the auth affordance for `` / PDF.js / download links, which cannot carry Authorization headers: the `?token=` media token rides along automatically. Responses carry `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable` — `public` is safe here, unlike the bearer-authenticated main route, because the `?token=` is part of the cache key.

200.description: The stored representation's bytes, verbatim, with the stored media type as Content-Type (`application/octet-stream` when none is recorded).

Link.description: `</resources/{id}/jsonld>; rel="describedby"; type="application/ld+json"` — where the resource's JSON-LD description is.

Cache-Control.description: Content is immutable; `public` is safe because the `?token=` is part of the cache key.

404.description: `Resource not found` when the knowledge base has no such resource, or the path's `{id}` is not a `ResourceId` and so names none; `Resource representation not found` when it has the resource but not its bytes.
